name: MKT_IMP_MAP
description: This table stores information about the import mapping which is the mapping from the staging table to individual attributes in the destination data store. It contains the header level details for the import mapping itself. The child entity "Import Mapping Column" holds the detailed column by column mapping information.

columns.name: IMPORT_MAP_ID
columns.description: This column holds import map id and, is a primary key.

columns.name: CLASSIC_MAP_ID
columns.description: Stored classic map id for standard map.

columns.name: CLASSIC_MAP_OBJECT
columns.description: Stored classic map object for standard map.

columns.name: IMPORT_TYPE
columns.description: This Column specifies whether the map created is from Claasic,Standard or simplified Import

columns.name: HEADER_ROW_INCLUDED
columns.description: Field indicates whether the Header row was included or not for the Map

columns.name: FILE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Input file type used for the map. Possible values are ZIP, CSV, XML and TXT

columns.name: EXTENSIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: To support the extensibility of maps for import  as optional choice.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Seeded Flag to indicate whether the map is a seeded map or not.

columns.name: VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Visible Flag to indicate wheter the map is going to be visible in the maps listing page.

columns.name: IMPORT_MAP_NUM
columns.description: This column holds import mapping numer and, is used for alternate key.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: This column holds import mapping name.

columns.name: DESC_TEXT
columns.description: This column holds mapping description text.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Import object type (lead, response, account, contact, prospect)

columns.name: LOCKED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the mapping is locked for editing

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: This column holds organization Identifier.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DECIMAL_SEPARATOR
columns.description: Decimal Separator in the file being imported

columns.name: DATE_FORMAT
columns.description: Date Format to be validated against for the incoming file data

columns.name: TIMESTAMP_FORMAT
columns.description: TimeStamp format to be validated against for incoming file data

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_NAME
columns.description: This column holds File Import Object Name

columns.name: IMPORT_MAP_TYPE
columns.description: This columns is to differentiate either system map or user map.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: OBJECT_PARENT_LIC
columns.description: Comma separated list of 'LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE' values used to identify potential parent of object of a current object. Will be used for hierarchical display purpose

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: These will be used for defining the security predicates.  Possible values could be: StandardObject, StandardChild, CustomChildOfStandard, CustomObject, CUstomChildOfCustom, IntersectionObject

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
